_comment_1: Settings read by the scripts in scripts/. Every key is optional; the values below are the defaults.
_comment_2: Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Regular expressions are strings, so backslashes are doubled.
_comment_3: GITHUB_REPOSITORY (set by GitHub Actions) decides which repo the scripts talk to; set "repo" only to override it.
_comment_tz: IANA time zone used for the dates merge-wrapup writes into the ledger.
_comment_cards: Heading in the task card (issue form) that lists the files the card may change. This is the file lock.

labels._comment: Open issues with any of these labels count as holding a file lock.

_comment_bot: PRs from branches with this prefix are bot PRs: merge-wrapup skips them so it does not trigger itself.
_comment_owner: Optional issue number of a pinned 'needs owner' checklist. merge-wrapup ticks items that say 'merge #PR'. null = off.
_comment_ignored: Paths that never count as outside a file lock (for example files that tools write automatically).

specSync._comment_notCode: Files matching these patterns do not need a spec update.
specSync._comment_seo: Optional second spec (for example an SEO spec): files that need it. Empty = off.
